title: Chats: one list of every chat, newest first, with its state, ticket and worktree

steps.caption: Every chat of every worktree in one list, newest first, whichever tab is selected
Each row: its state in a word, the ticket it belongs to, and the worktree it runs in
Flotilla's agents are greyed with a gear: they work on their own
A click on a row's ticket opens it
